description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans Stateless Worker grains, verifying behaviors such as activation limits, exception handling, concurrency, and load distribution in multi-silo deployments.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans Stateless Worker grain behaviors, including activation limits, exception handling, concurrency, and multi-silo deployment scenarios.

classes.name: CallbackObserver
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ICallbackGrainObserver to facilitate callback testing within the stateless worker tests.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerThrowExceptionConstructor
methods.description: Tests that exceptions thrown during the construction of stateless worker grains are properly reported and handled.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerActivationsPerSiloDoNotExceedMaxLocalWorkersCount
methods.description: Verifies that the number of local activations for a stateless worker does not exceed the configured maximum per silo.

methods.name: ManyConcurrentInvocationsOnActivationLimitedStatelessWorkerDoesNotFail
methods.description: Ensures system stability under high concurrency with limited worker activations, checking for message forwarding issues.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerFastActivationsDontFailInMultiSiloDeployment
methods.description: Tests that rapid concurrent activations across multiple silos do not cause forwarding failures (currently skipped).

methods.name: StatelessWorker_DoesNotThrow_IfMarkedWithMayInterleave
methods.description: Verifies that methods marked with MayInterleave can process concurrently within a stateless worker.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldNotInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedDoesntMatch
methods.description: Ensures that calls with a false MayInterleave predicate execute sequentially.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedMatches
methods.description: Verifies that calls with a true MayInterleave predicate can execute concurrently.

methods.name: CallbackObserver.Signal
methods.description: Method to signal the observer to proceed, used in callback synchronization tests.

methods.name: CallbackObserver.OnCallback
methods.description: Task that completes when the callback is invoked, used to wait for callback execution.
